plan.notes: Official Rio Hondo College Guided Pathways sample education plan (pathways.riohondo.edu), 2026-2027 catalog year. The page's main sample plan is used (Cal-GETC pattern); the alternate fully-online map in the page's dropdown is not modeled. Term-by-term sequence transcribed from the published program map. Total 62.5 units = sum of published pathway slots. Fixed courses list only Advisories or placement-based requirements in their published descriptions (PSY 190: placement via HS GPA/other measures or a pre-statistics/intermediate algebra course; ENGL C1000/STAT C1000: placement) — not modeled as course prereqs since no plan course satisfies them. PSY 200 (available inside two 'Select One' major slots) carries an official prerequisite of PSYC C1000 or PSYC C1000H and PSY 190 or STAT C1000 or STAT C1000H; PSYC C1000 is not part of this pathway — noted on those slots. Choice slots model the official 'Select One' requirements; see choice notes. Dagger (†): some GE choice classes may carry higher units; slots encoded at published values.

courses.title: Statistics for the Behavioral Sciences or Introduction to Statistics
courses.choice_note: Select one per the official map (Cal-GETC 2; marked M). PSY 190 is the preferred math/quantitative reasoning course for Behavioral and Social Science majors. PSY 190 official prerequisite: enrollment requires appropriate placement (based on high school GPA and/or other measures), or completion of a pre-statistics or an intermediate algebra course (not a plan course). STAT C1000/C1000H official prerequisite: placement or completion of a course at or above elementary algebra (not a plan course).
